title: Good product.
text: Good product.. Used this product for a pepakura mask and it worked really well.  It took overnight to cure fully on the cardstock but it harden up nicely.  I mixed it up in equal amounts and then brushed it on the mask.  I recommend this for any cosplayer.

product_metadata.title: ENVIRONMENTAL Watercolor Stains Sealers tal tools products, Clear, 16 Fl Oz Pack of 1 US
features: ONE COAT APPLICATION: No need to apply 60 coats of varnish to achieve a deep pour attractive finish. Only one coat of EnviroTex Lite, Unless you need an extra layer of thickness, with only one coat of EnviroTex Lite - you’re done!

CONVENIENT 1:1 MIX: No complicated procedures here - measure equal amounts of resin and hardener into a container, and you've got your crystal epoxy resin finish. Don’t forget to double mix for it to blend chemically

NO POLISHING REQUIRED: Achieve a high-gloss finish with zero polishing efforts. It cures in 8 hours and reaches full strength and hardness in about 72 hours. This 2-part kit is enough to cover up to 32 sq. ft. surface
IDEAL FOR BAR & TABLE TOPS: Give your old furniture a brand-new look with EnviroTex Lite! This lustrous coat makes your countertop heat-resistant, waterproof, and alcohol-proof

UNIQUE SELF-LEVELING QUALITIES: Worried about the uneven surface? Our innovative epoxy coating systems naturally self-level to approximately 1/16 inches, making them the best choice for larger projects
16-Ounce kit covers approximately 4 square feet at 1/16-Ounce
description: Envirotex lite is a reactive polymer compound. It cures to a thick, glossy coating in about 8-hour at 70-Degree f, and reaches full strength and toughness in about 72-hour. This durable, resilient material requires no polishing to produce a high gloss. One coat is all that is usually required for a deep attractive finish. However, two or more coats maybe applied one over the other by simply wiping the surface with a clean cloth and alcohol prior to recoating. Envirotex lite may be used on wood, fabric, decals, bisque, photos, paper, metal, models, painted surfaces, dried flowers, plaster, rocks, sea shells, bread dough, styrofoam, and more. Item is non-returnable.
